meta.note: Document checklists recorded from public sources. Requirements change per call: check the source before relying on a list.

WBSO.channel: Online application portal of RVO, login with eHerkenning level 3

documents.item: eHerkenning level 3 login with an 'RVO services level 3' authorisation
documents.note: An intermediary needs a chain authorisation (ketenmachtiging) to act for you.

documents.item: Company registration numbers (KVK number and RSIN)
documents.note: A BV in formation has no KVK number yet and applies by email to wbso@rvo.nl instead.

documents.item: Project form (projectformulier), one per S&O project
documents.note: Filled in per project and uploaded at step 5 (Projects) of the application, not added as an attachment. Not needed for projects continued from earlier applications.

documents.item: Key project dates
documents.note: Start and end of each project. Apply before the project starts.

documents.item: BSN numbers of your S&O employees
documents.note: Needed if you received an S&O statement two years ago, so RVO can work out the average S&O hourly wage.

documents.item: Estimate of S&O costs or expenditure up to 31 December
documents.note: Needed if you are an employer applying for actual costs and expenditure.

documents.item: S&O administration: hours per person, per project
documents.note: Must support your realised hours; RVO can check by site visit or desk review. Based on RVO's control page and an older handbook, so check the current rules.

documents.item: Realisation statement (WBSO-realisatiemelding) with realised hours, costs and employee BSNs
documents.note: Due after the calendar year; an adviser gives 31 March, so confirm the date on RVO's page.

WBSO.notes: Apply before the project starts. For a 1 January 2027 start, employers must apply by 20 December 2026 (RVO news). Employers can file up to four applications per calendar year; RVO usually decides within about three months (adviser source).

sources.label: adviser guide to the five steps

INNOVATIEBOX.channel: No application: you elect the innovation box in your corporate income tax return

documents.item: Corporate income tax liability
documents.note: The company pays vennootschapsbelasting, for example a BV or NV.

documents.item: S&O statement (from WBSO) for the work that created the asset
documents.note: Smaller taxpayers need this. Larger taxpayers need it plus a patent or equivalent.

documents.item: Patent, breeder's right or medicine marketing authorisation
documents.note: Needed in addition to the S&O statement for larger taxpayers.

documents.item: Administration showing how the benefits of the intangible asset are determined
documents.note: Smaller taxpayers also keep evidence that they meet the extra conditions.

documents.item: Election of the innovation box in the tax return
documents.note: Can also be made later, as long as the assessment for that year is not final.

documents.item: Box threshold calculation
documents.note: Benefits enter the box only once the production costs have been offset.

INNOVATIEBOX.notes: This is a tax election run by the Belastingdienst, not a grant application to RVO. The S&O statement comes from a WBSO application.

EIA.channel: RVO application portal (eLoket), login with eHerkenning; then claim the deduction in your tax return

documents.item: eHerkenning login with an RVO services authorisation
documents.note: RVO's page says to log in with eHerkenning. Adviser sources give level 2+; confirm the level on RVO's page.

documents.item: Code of the investment on the Energielijst
documents.note: Check before investing that the asset is on the Energielijst for the year of the order.

documents.item: Date of the order or purchase agreement
documents.note: This starts the three-month deadline. Not the quote, installation, invoice or payment date.

documents.item: KVK number and company details
documents.note: Listed as standard preparation by an adviser.

documents.item: Invoices or order confirmation and specifications of the asset
documents.note: An adviser lists these as things to have ready; RVO may ask for them.

documents.item: Proof of required permits and certificates
documents.note: Needed when the Energielijst description of the asset requires them.

documents.item: Extra technical documents or photos
documents.note: RVO sometimes asks for these during assessment (adviser source).

documents.item: EIA claimed in the income or corporate tax return
documents.note: Keep RVO's confirmation of receipt and the decision for your records (adviser source).

EIA.notes: Apply within three months of the order; for production costs, within three months after the quarter in which they were incurred. RVO usually decides within eight weeks. Choose the form for the year of the order. An asset that receives ISDE cannot also get EIA.

MIA_VAMIL.channel: RVO application portal (one form for EIA, MIA or Vamil), login with eHerkenning; then claim in your tax return

documents.item: eHerkenning level 2+ with the authorisation 'RVO services level 2+' or 'All services level 2+'
documents.note: With a RSIN but no KVK number, use the button 'Apply without chain authorisation'.

documents.item: Code of the investment on the Milieulijst
documents.note: Use the list valid on the day you place the order or sign the purchase agreement.

documents.item: Date of the purchase agreement or order
documents.note: Starts the three-month deadline. Not the quote, invoice, installation or payment date.

documents.item: Minimum investment of EUR 2,500 per application
documents.note: As set out in RVO's conditions page.

documents.item: Copies of certificates, permits and reports
documents.note: Needed when the Milieulijst description of the asset requires them. RVO may ask for them after you apply.

documents.item: Environmental advice report
documents.note: Advice costs are applied for together with acquisition or production costs; the advice must recommend your investment and the investment must follow within 24 months.

documents.item: MIA and Vamil applied in the tax return
documents.note: RVO emails a receipt with a reference number within hours, and usually decides within eight weeks of getting all information.

MIA_VAMIL.notes: Apply within three months of the purchase agreement (production costs: within three months after the quarter they were incurred). RVO sends a message within 10 working days if it needs more information.

sources.label: RVO MIA and Vamil for entrepreneurs

ISDE.channel: RVO eLoket, login with eHerkenning (DigiD only if you have no KVK number). Apply first, then buy

documents.item: eHerkenning level 2+ with the 'RVO services level eH2+' authorisation
documents.note: Without a KVK number you can use DigiD instead.

documents.item: ISDE meldcode of the device (heat pump or solar boiler)
documents.note: Taken from the meldcode list of the year you apply. A small wind turbine needs no meldcode.

documents.item: Product description and technical documentation
documents.note: Sent in with the application for a small wind turbine, or for a device without a meldcode.

documents.item: Application filed before you accept a quote, reserve or install
documents.note: Applications made afterwards are rejected.

documents.item: Invoice and proof of payment for the purchase and installation
documents.note: Per an adviser: the installation must be done by a building-installation company. RVO's own list for business users was not read in full.

documents.item: Device in use within 12 months of the decision, and kept for a year
documents.note: Adviser source: do not sell or remove the device within a year.

ISDE.notes: One application can cover several devices or a collective installation. An adviser says 90% of applications are decided within eight weeks. An asset that gets ISDE cannot also get EIA.
ISDE.confidence: official page read, later steps from an adviser

SDE_PP.channel: RVO digital application environment, login with eHerkenning level 3 (or DigiD); attachments go in the last tab of the form, mandatory ones marked with an asterisk

documents.item: eHerkenning level 3 with the 'RVO services level eH3' authorisation (or DigiD)
documents.note: Apply for it early: processing takes several working days.

documents.item: Feasibility study using RVO's 'Model haalbaarheidsstudie SDE++' (Excel)
documents.note: Covers the project description, energy or product yield calculation, operating calculation, financing plan and the applicant's equity. An incomplete study means the application is not handled.

documents.item: Most recent annual accounts (jaarrekening) or balance sheet
documents.note: A mandatory part of the feasibility study: shows the company is financially healthy and the money is available at the time of investing.

documents.item: Copies of all required permits
documents.note: You must already hold the permits when you apply. Which permits depend on the technology.

documents.item: Landowner's consent for the site
documents.note: RVO provides a form on its downloads page.

documents.item: Documents to show the company is not in difficulty
documents.note: The list is on RVO's attachments page; it was not captured in full here.

documents.item: Grid transport indication
documents.note: Extra attachment for the renewable electricity category.

documents.item: Technique-specific attachments
documents.note: Examples from RVO guidance: a structural engineer's statement for rooftop solar; a geological report for geothermal; a grid operator statement for larger renewable gas projects (from the 2024 handbook, so check the current one).

SDE_PP.notes: Attachments differ by technology; RVO's attachments page lists them per category. The 2026 round opened 27 October 2026.

VEKI.channel: RVO digital application, login with eHerkenning level 3 (an intermediary uses their own eHerkenning); attachments follow RVO's models

documents.item: Project plan (RVO model)
documents.note: Use RVO's model project plan; the VEKI handbook explains the attachments.

documents.item: Budget
Financial substantiation of your own contribution
SME statement (mkb-verklaring)
documents.note: Filled in on RVO's SME statement page and saved as PDF.

documents.item: Payback calculation
documents.note: Must show the payback time would be more than five years without the subsidy.

documents.item: Cost-effectiveness and CO2 calculation
Statement 'VEKI application: no EML measures'
Statement 'not an undertaking in difficulty', with decision scheme
documents.note: The company must not be an undertaking in difficulty as defined in the EU block exemption regulation.

documents.item: Latest (consolidated) annual report
documents.note: Part of the proof that the company is not in difficulty.

documents.item: Organisation chart of the legal structure and shareholdings of the group
documents.note: Part of the proof that the company is not in difficulty.

VEKI.notes: Minimum subsidy of EUR 125,000 for a large company or EUR 30,000 for an SME. The 2026 round runs from 7 May 2026 to 28 January 2027. No work may start before you apply.

INNOVATIEKREDIET.channel: RVO portal, login with eHerkenning (RVO's application page says level 2+, an adviser says level 3: confirm); start with the optional Quick Scan; applications can be filed all year and are handled in order of completeness

documents.item: eHerkenning login with an RVO services authorisation
documents.note: RVO's application-process page says level 2+ with the 'RVO services eH2+' authorisation. An adviser, and the earlier scheme row, say level 3, so confirm the level when you register.

documents.item: 1. Business plan (free form)
documents.note: Market size, competitive position, customer value and revenue model, backed with figures where possible.

documents.item: 2. Project plan (free form)
documents.note: Status of the technology, technical feasibility and what is unique; a systematic plan with measurable milestones, based on a technical risk analysis.

documents.item: 3. Financing plan (free form): project budget, company finances and cash flow until repayment
documents.note: Use RVO's 'Financieel model Innovatiekrediet' Excel file for the project budget.

documents.item: 4. Evidence of other financing for the project and the company
documents.note: For the project period. Examples: signed term sheets, loan agreements, investment agreements and customer agreements.

documents.item: 5. Latest annual accounts (or opening balance) and financial reporting for the current year
6. Outcome of the SME test (mkb-toets)
documents.note: Sets the credit percentage; in a partnership the maximum can rise to 50% or 40%.

documents.item: 7. Legal organisation structure of the whole company
8. Chamber of Commerce (KVK) extracts
documents.note: For the applying entity and the entities in the direct line of control above it.

documents.item: 9. UBO statement
documents.note: A UBO extract from the KVK or RVO's completed UBO form.

documents.item: 10. Articles of association (statuten)
documents.note: Of the applying entity and the entities in the direct line of control above it.

documents.item: 11. Decision scheme and statement 'not an undertaking in difficulty'
documents.note: Both must be submitted. Use the latest final annual figures, with a balance date no older than 18 months. If you cannot give the statement yet, describe the transactions that will lift the status.

documents.item: Project and hours administration kept for the whole project
documents.note: RVO's terms of award; agree the detail with your accountant.

documents.item: Progress reports, yearly accounts and forecasts during the project
documents.note: Reports within four weeks after each period; annual accounts yearly; a quarterly profit-and-loss and cash-flow forecast until the credit is repaid.

documents.item: Settlement report and audit statement
documents.note: Due within 13 weeks after the project ends.

INNOVATIEKREDIET.notes: This is a loan, not a grant. The attachments page was checked by RVO on 13 January 2026. The pledge agreement and guarantees are part of RVO's terms of award.
INNOVATIEKREDIET.confidence: official attachments page read in full; only the eHerkenning level differs between sources

STUDI.channel: RVO application portal, login with eHerkenning (an intermediary uses their own eHerkenning); applications are handled in order of arrival

documents.item: Project plan (RVO model, STUDI 2026)
documents.note: Maximum 20 pages excluding attachments.

documents.item: Budget (RVO model)
De minimis declaration
documents.note: States how much government support the company has received. Up to EUR 300,000 per three years applies to companies in difficulty.

documents.item: Decision scheme and statement 'not an undertaking in difficulty'
documents.note: Filled in digitally in the form; every participant in a partnership must not be in difficulty. Sign and attach both documents.

documents.item: SME statement (mkb-verklaring)
documents.note: For small and medium-sized companies.

documents.item: Partnership agreement
documents.note: Relevant when applying as a partnership; RVO sets extra conditions for partnerships (see RVO's page).

STUDI.notes: The 2026 round runs from 18 May 2026 to 31 March 2027. The scheme was called TSE Industrie studies until 2026. The data row also lists a management statement or audit report for payout, which this run did not re-check.

MKB_EBL.channel: RVO online application (button on RVO's page) after the RVO Quickscan; login with eHerkenning level 3

documents.item: RVO Quickscan
documents.note: Done first: checks company type, energy use, the measures and the amount.

documents.item: eHerkenning level 3 with an 'RVO services' authorisation
documents.note: It can take several days to arrange.

documents.item: Quote for the energy-saving measures, including any extra work needed
documents.note: The measures must be on RVO's measures list. Up to 50% of the loan may fund necessary extra work such as demolition.

documents.item: Most recent annual invoice from your energy supplier
documents.note: For electricity and, if you have it, gas. It shows your energy use; the minimum is 10,000 kWh of electricity or 5,000 m3 of gas equivalent a year.

documents.item: Your two most recent annual accounts
documents.note: Lets RVO judge whether you can repay. Start-ups cannot apply yet.

documents.item: Partnership or general-partnership contract
documents.note: For a maatschap or VOF with joint authority.

documents.item: Latest income tax return of owners holding 50% or more
documents.note: For natural persons who directly or indirectly hold 50% or more of the shares.

documents.item: Copy of the shareholder register
documents.note: For a BV with more than one shareholder.

documents.item: Personal guarantee (borgstelling) from owners holding 50% or more
documents.note: For a BV: those owners guarantee repayment personally, so everyone involved, including spouses and registered partners, should know before you apply.

documents.item: Keep documents and invoices for at least five years
documents.note: RVO checks that the loan is used correctly.

MKB_EBL.notes: Loan of EUR 10,000 to EUR 250,000 per location, up to 7 years at 6.9% in this round. Applications from 1 Oct to 11 Dec 2026 are handled in order of receipt; RVO expects four rounds in total, the second around March 2027. Start the measures within 18 months of approval. A separate application is needed per location. RVO's page was checked on 19 Oct 2026.
MKB_EBL.confidence: official RVO page read in full (checked 19 Oct 2026) and the RVO Quickscan

NIKI.channel: RVO application forms in Mijn RVO, login with eHerkenning level 3; tender, so only complete applications are handled

documents.item: eHerkenning level 3 with an RVO services authorisation
documents.note: Allow about two weeks to obtain it. An intermediary uses their own eHerkenning.

documents.item: 'NIKI rekenmodel CO2-emissiereductie' (CO2 reduction calculation model)
documents.note: Mandatory. RVO replaced an earlier version that had bugs, so use the one under the attachments.

documents.item: NIKI subsidy calculation sheet
documents.note: The second mandatory calculation sheet; the method is set out in the regulation.

documents.item: Project plan, including a public summary
documents.note: An application without the minimum required parts is incomplete and is not handled.

documents.item: Climate plan
documents.note: Described in RVO's instruction for the project plan and climate plan (June 2025 version).

documents.item: Accountant's work on the data you submit, following the NIKI accountant protocol
documents.note: RVO's protocol (COPRO 26030, version of 4 Nov 2026) sets what the accountant must check.

documents.item: Budget (begroting) covering the total costs of the eligible activities
documents.note: The accountant's protocol names the budget included in the application as the object of the accountant's examination.

documents.item: Accountant's examination of future financial information (standard 3400)
documents.note: The accountant follows standard 3400; RVO provides no model report.

documents.item: Basic engineering finished at the time of applying
documents.note: From an adviser: it is the basis for the mandatory CO2 and subsidy calculations. Confirm in RVO's regulation.

NIKI.notes: The full list of required attachments (for example budget and financing proof) was not captured here; RVO's page lists them under 'Bijlagen'. RVO's page was last checked on 11 June 2026 and still referred to the earlier round, so confirm the 2026 round's details. A search result that listed project plan, budget and own-contribution attachments belonged to a different scheme (VEKI) and was not used. The accountant protocol also says the project must achieve a CO2 reduction of at least 100,000 tonnes against the reference product. RVO's own attachments list for the 2026 round still could not be read in full, so this stays partly recorded.

sources.label: RVO instruction for project plan and climate plan

NIKI.confidence: official protocol and instruction documents read; RVO's attachments list for the 2026 round not read in full

BMKB.channel: Not applied for by the company: the accredited lender (bank or other financier) files it with RVO as part of your credit application

documents.item: Credit application at an accredited lender
documents.note: RVO says the BMKB application coincides with your credit application and the lender decides; you only ask the lender to use the guarantee scheme.

documents.item: Recent annual figures, tax return or business-account transaction data
documents.note: Typical requests from lenders per the Chamber of Commerce; each lender decides what it needs.

documents.item: Business plan with budgets and an opening balance
documents.note: For a start-up, per the Chamber of Commerce.

documents.item: Quote for the asset, or property details, or debtor data
documents.note: Depends on the purpose: lease, real estate or factoring.

documents.item: Substantiation of the credit need and, for a BV, an organisation chart of shareholders
documents.note: From a bank association checklist for the scheme, written for the earlier Covid-era BMKB-C, so treat as indicative.

BMKB.notes: There is no fixed official document list: it varies by lender and purpose. The scheme is reported as extended to 1 July 2027 (adviser source; the dataset row also says open to 30 Jun 2027).

sources.label: Chamber of Commerce: how to apply for financing

BMKB.confidence: official page read for the process; document lists are lender-dependent and partly from older or secondary sources

MIT_FEAS.channel: Regional desk of your province or region (portal login with eHerkenning of the applying company); the list below differs by region

documents.item: Project plan using the region's model
documents.note: The one document required in every region seen. In Gelderland it is the only mandatory attachment.

documents.item: SME statement (mkb-verklaring) in the region's format
documents.note: Mandatory in Noord-Holland and Noord-Nederland; check your region.

documents.item: De minimis declaration
documents.note: Mandatory in Noord-Holland.

documents.item: Organisation chart showing partner and linked companies
documents.note: Mandatory in Noord-Holland if the SME is part of a holding.

documents.item: Specification of the budget and planning, and quotes
documents.note: Listed by Noord-Holland; the southern provinces ask for a budget with the application form.

documents.item: Chamber of Commerce (KVK) extract
documents.note: Listed by Noord-Holland.

documents.item: eHerkenning of the company that carries out the project
documents.note: The KVK number on the login must match the applicant; an intermediary needs a chain authorisation.

MIT_FEAS.notes: Only one SME may apply per project (two collaborating SMEs cannot apply together). The schemes are usually oversubscribed on opening day, so complete documents on day one matter. South: 'MIT Zuid' application form with project plan model and budget (Stimulus factsheet).
MIT_FEAS.confidence: official regional pages read; lists differ per region and were not read for every region

FZULG.channel: Two steps: certificate from the BSFZ via its web portal, then the allowance application at your tax office via Mein ELSTER

documents.item: Registration at the BSFZ web portal
documents.note: Step 1; the application is fully digital.

documents.item: ELSTER organisation certificate
documents.note: Needed for the BSFZ application, per chamber of commerce sources.

documents.item: Company master data and statistical data
documents.note: The only documents the funding database lists.

documents.item: Project description following the BSFZ's outline, cost calculation and project plan
documents.note: Per a chamber of commerce source; multiple R&D projects can be bundled in one application.

documents.item: BSFZ certificate (Bescheinigung)
documents.note: Issued after step 1 and sent to your tax office directly. It must exist before you apply at the tax office.

documents.item: Application for the allowance in Mein ELSTER, one per financial year
documents.note: Filed after the end of each financial year. No receipts and not even the BSFZ certificate need to be attached.

documents.item: Records of R&D hours per employee and supporting documents
documents.note: Hours should be recorded systematically so eligible wage costs can be shown if the tax office checks (law firm guidance).

FZULG.notes: The BSFZ decides on eligibility of the R&D, the tax office on the amount. The BSFZ normally decides within about three months of complete documents (adviser and funding database say up to three months) and does not charge a fee (adviser source).
FZULG.confidence: official pages read (via search snippets); lists of what the BSFZ form asks for come from chamber sources

BIK_M2_TM2_R3.channel: Stage I: sketch submitted by the project coordinator to Projektträger Jülich (PtJ) through the easy-Online system; stage II: formal funding application on invitation

documents.item: Submission through easy-Online by the consortium coordinator

documents.item: Formal funding application
documents.note: Stage II, filed after your sketch has been selected.

BIK_M2_TM2_R3.notes: Third call: sketches from 19 Oct to 6 Dec 2026. Funding depends on the 2027 federal budget law. The guideline says research institutions, companies, municipal bodies and universities are eligible.

BIK_M1_TM3_R3.channel: Two stages: project sketch and then an application, both online with the project agency KEI (Kompetenzzentrum Klimaschutz in energieintensiven Industrien)

documents.item: Project sketch submitted to KEI
documents.note: Open from 19 Oct to 6 Dec 2026. KEI's own sketch template and page limit were not captured in this run; check KEI's call page.

documents.item: Formal application online at KEI
documents.note: Stage II, after your sketch is selected.

BIK_M1_TM3_R3.notes: For this research call the funding ceiling per project is up to EUR 35M, according to a chamber source. KEI ran a free online workshop to help applicants prepare sketches for the second call. Funding depends on the 2027 federal budget law.

EBN.channel: Online application in the BAFA portal, filed before you sign a contract with the energy adviser

documents.note: Must be filed before a legally binding service contract with the adviser is signed.

documents.item: An approved energy adviser from the official expert list
documents.note: The adviser must be listed in the category 'Energieberatung für Nichtwohngebäude' on energie-effizienz-experten.de.

documents.item: Quote from the adviser for the consultation
documents.note: An adviser source lists choosing an adviser and obtaining a quote as the first step.

EEW.channel: Grant: electronic application form on the BAFA website (Modules 1 to 4 and 6; Module 5, the transformation plan, goes through VDI/VDE). Credit: through your bank, which applies to KfW (programme 295). Either way, before the measure starts

documents.item: Electronic application form
documents.note: Covers general company details, the planned measures and spending, and information on de minimis aid.

documents.item: Application filed before the measure starts
documents.note: Possible until 31 Dec 2028 under the guideline of 25 Jan 2024. For the credit route the application goes to your bank first.

documents.item: SME classification: self-declaration (annexes 3 to 5) with the SME definition leaflet
documents.note: Module 1 is open to SMEs only; the declaration also sets the aid rate.

documents.item: De minimis declaration
documents.note: Listed among the forms for the grant.

documents.item: Request for early start of the measure
documents.note: A BAFA form for when you want to start before the decision.

documents.item: Data sheet 'Prozesswärme' (process heat)
documents.note: For Module 2: collects the key data of the project.

documents.item: Energy-saving concept (online form)
documents.note: Listed among the forms; relevant to the optimisation module.

documents.item: Manufacturer declaration proving eligibility

documents.item: Technical minimum requirements for Module 1

documents.item: Waiver declaration (EEG/KWKG) and declaration on contracting, rental or off-site use

This list follows the official forms page and the annexes; module-by-module detail is in the BAFA leaflet, which was not read in full. KfW annex with technical minimum requirements for Module 1

documents.item: Energy-efficiency expert from the official dena expert list
documents.note: Mandatory. The category must be 'Nichtwohngebäude' (for 263: 'Effizienzgebäude'; for 522: 'BEG Nichtwohngebäude'). For single measures a specialist company can do this.

documents.item: Commercial confirmation to the application (gBzA) and its 15-character ID

documents.item: Documented advisory discussion

documents.item: Application before the start of works
documents.note: Delivery or service contracts and the start of construction count as the start and rule out funding; for a purchase, apply before the first payment.

documents.item: Signed supply or service contract, or proof of the tender procedure
documents.note: Uploaded with the heating grant application (522).

documents.item: Company proofs in 'Meine KfW'
documents.note: The documents depend on company type and legal form; KfW lists them on its proofs page for companies.

documents.item: Commercial confirmation after completion (gBnD)
documents.note: Issued by the expert or specialist company; handed to the bank (263) or the KfW portal (522) to release the repayment grant or payout.

documents.item: Proof that the building permit application is at least five years old

GSTIP_NRW.channel: Apply through a certified founder network in your region (a Gründungsnetzwerk): ideas paper, jury pitch, then a web form provided with Projektträger Jülich

documents.item: Ideas paper (Ideenpapier) submitted to the founder network
documents.note: A meaningful ideas paper is the precondition for applying; pick a certified network close to where you live or where the company will be based.

documents.item: Proof of main residence in NRW and age of at least 18
documents.note: Founders must live in NRW and pursue the start-up as their main occupation in NRW.

documents.item: Personal pitch to the jury
documents.note: Five minutes of presentation plus five minutes of questions, per chamber sources; juries meet on set dates per network.

documents.item: Idea judged on five criteria
documents.note: Founder or team, innovativeness, feasibility, customer benefit and need, and economic prospects, per the guideline and an FAQ.

documents.item: Web application form via the founder network
documents.note: Filed after a positive jury recommendation, in a form arranged by the network and provided by Projektträger Jülich.

documents.item: Coaching plan with your network
documents.note: Coaching is compulsory during the support period.

GSTIP_NRW.notes: From 1 October 2026 you apply before the company is formed and found it during the stipend. Example jury dates at one network (IHK Bonn): 29 Oct, 26 Nov and 17 Dec 2026. The Diversität+ supplement is applied for between the 7th and 12th month of the stipend, after formation.

EIC_ACC.channel: EIC's online submission platform; three steps: short application, full application, interview with the EIC jury

documents.item: Short application form
documents.note: Step 1. The EIC's template page describes a 5-page form on the innovation, market and team; two secondary sources say 12 pages, so check the current template.

documents.item: Pitch deck of up to 10 slides, as a PDF
documents.note: Step 1.

documents.item: Video pitch of up to 3 minutes
documents.note: Step 1; the core team (up to three people) explains the motivation behind the application.

documents.item: Full application form of 20 pages
documents.note: Step 2: expands on the short proposal template.

documents.note: Annexes to the full application.

EIC_STEP.channel: EU Funding & Tenders Portal submission; you can submit when ready, with batches evaluated together; eligible applicants are invited to an EIC jury interview

documents.item: Full business plan of at most 50 pages
documents.note: Covers the company, its ownership and financial structure, and its contribution to the STEP objectives. Pages beyond 50 are excluded from evaluation.

documents.item: Pitch deck of at most 15 pages, as a PDF
documents.note: This version is presented to the jury if you are invited to interview.

documents.item: Equity pre-commitment from a single qualified investor, on the official template
documents.note: Must cover at least 20% of the total target funding round (for a EUR 100M round, at least EUR 20M). Syndicated pre-commitments are ineligible if no single entity reaches 20%. The 20% portion must be uninvested at the date of the letter.

documents.item: Financial plan, on the EIC template
documents.note: The template is on the EIC website.

documents.item: Freedom-to-operate (FTO) analysis and CVs of key employees
documents.note: Listed by an Austrian funding agency and a consultancy; confirm in the call text.

documents.item: Letters of intent
documents.note: Listed on the EIC's page for the defence variant of the call; check whether the general call asks for them.

documents.item: Guarantee if the outcome gives direct or indirect control
documents.note: Named on the defence variant's page.

EIC_STEP.notes: The pre-commitment investor must have demonstrable experience in the market and technology and is checked by the EIC Fund or EIF. If that investor is not the lead, the EIC Fund's investment usually also depends on a qualified lead investor (EIC FAQ). Equity-only, typically EUR 10M to EUR 30M; the Accelerator needs no pre-commitment.

HORIZON.channel: EU Funding & Tenders Portal submission system; the call's topic page sets the template, deadline and page limits

documents.item: EU Login account

documents.item: Administrative forms (Part A)
documents.note: Completed online in the submission wizard: participants, contact persons, budget, declarations, and ethics questions.

documents.item: Technical description (Part B), uploaded as a PDF

documents.item: Annexes and supporting documents required by the call
documents.note: Examples named by guides: CVs and letters of commitment. Each call states what it requires.

documents.item: Ethics and security self-assessment

documents.item: Consortium of the minimum size set by the topic
